What changed:
- `slugify` in blog.py now lowercases the title and turns whitespace into hyphens. It drops everything except a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, collapses repeated hyphens and trims hyphens from both ends. If nothing is left it returns "untitled".
- "Hello World" still gives "hello-world". "Hello, World!" gives "hello-world" and "Don't stop" gives "dont-stop".
- I added 6 tests next to your 3 originals. `read_post` and `output_path` are untouched.

What I haven't checked:

- **Accents:** Accented letters are dropped, so "Café" becomes "caf". You said you have no such titles.

The test result comes from the run I requested in this session. I couldn't put it on the claim ledger because no tool for that is available here, so nobody has independently verified it. You can re-run `pytest` yourself to confirm.

Before you rebuild, it's worth listing the titles that contain punctuation. That shows which URLs will move and whether any two will collide. I can write a small script for that if you'd like. The open risks are saved as notes for the next session.

diff --git a/blog.py b/blog.py
index d3a7114..13c7e64 100644
--- a/blog.py
+++ b/blog.py
@@ -13,8 +13,17 @@ def read_post(text):
 
 
 def slugify(title):
-    """URL part for a post title."""
-    return title.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    """URL part for a post title.
+
+    Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens are kept. Whitespace becomes a
+    hyphen, every other character is dropped, repeated hyphens collapse to one,
+    and hyphens at the start or end are removed. A title with nothing left
+    gives "untitled".
+    """
+    slug = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", title.lower())
+    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", slug)
+    slug = re.sub(r"-+", "-", slug).strip("-")
+    return slug or "untitled"
 
 
 def output_path(meta):
diff --git a/tests/test_blog.py b/tests/test_blog.py
index e5719a9..2fc6e73 100644
--- a/tests/test_blog.py
+++ b/tests/test_blog.py
@@ -13,3 +13,35 @@ def test_simple_title():
 
 def test_output_path():
     assert blog.output_path({"title": "My First Post"}) == "posts/my-first-post.html"
+
+
+def test_punctuation_is_removed():
+    assert blog.slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
+    assert blog.slugify("What is this? A test: part #1") == "what-is-this-a-test-part-1"
+    assert blog.slugify("Don't stop") == "dont-stop"
+    assert blog.slugify("Tom & Jerry/Friends") == "tom-jerryfriends"
+
+
+def test_repeated_spaces_and_hyphens_collapse():
+    assert blog.slugify("Hello    World") == "hello-world"
+    assert blog.slugify("Hello - World") == "hello-world"
+    assert blog.slugify("a--b") == "a-b"
+
+
+def test_no_leading_or_trailing_hyphen():
+    assert blog.slugify("  Hello World  ") == "hello-world"
+    assert blog.slugify("...Hello World?!") == "hello-world"
+    assert blog.slugify("-Hello-") == "hello"
+
+
+def test_digits_are_kept():
+    assert blog.slugify("Top 10 Tips") == "top-10-tips"
+
+
+def test_empty_result_falls_back():
+    assert blog.slugify("?!?") == "untitled"
+    assert blog.slugify("") == "untitled"
+
+
+def test_output_path_with_punctuation():
+    assert blog.output_path({"title": "Hello, World?"}) == "posts/hello-world.html"
